description: The three levels of support available to people, teams, and organizations building AI-Augmented capability.

levels.name: Learn
levels.description: Build understanding before changing the work through free educational material.
levels.audience: Anyone beginning or strengthening their AI-Augmented practice.
levels.access: Free; learning assets may use the shop's $0 access flow.

levels.name: Apply
levels.description: Use practical assets to apply the framework to a real workflow, team, department, or institutional challenge.
levels.audience: Practitioners and leaders ready to put the concepts into practice.
levels.access: Paid; self-service assets are delivered through the shop.

levels.name: Augment
levels.description: Work with experts through guided support that expands capability across people, teams, and organizations.
levels.audience: Leaders and institutions facing work that needs facilitation, assessment, or sustained support.
levels.access: Paid; guided support begins with a conversation about context and need.
